supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension of the ridge beyond the outer corner of the left eye, forming a distinct lateral shelf.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light tan/pinkish muzzle and the dark charcoal-toned periocular region.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin 2D vertical thickness with a straight, neutral horizontal alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark-pigmented mottling/freckling distributed across the lighter skin of the muzzle and labial area.
